reference.question: Show the record companies shared by orchestras founded before 2003 and after 2003.
reference.gold_sql: SELECT Record_Company FROM orchestra WHERE Year_of_Founded < 2003 INTERSECT SELECT Record_Company FROM orchestra WHERE Year_of_Founded > 2003
